trap.label: be likely
trap.right: She is likely to win the prize.
trap.why: O brasileiro omite o verbo be. Em inglês, é be likely to + verbo base.

opts: It is probable that it will rain.

mcq.q: Forma negativa de "They are likely to agree":

opts: Is he likely to be late?

fix.why: Evite dupla negação para dizer improvável.

fix.right: The team is likely to win.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para pergunta: “He is likely to win.”
Reescreva com likely: “It is probable that he will agree.”
Reescreva com unlikely: “It isn't likely to snow.”
